svg.aria-label: RedStrike Dual-Engine Active Directory Assessment Architecture

g.text: Deterministic Attack Graphs & Autonomous AI Agency for Active Directory, ADCS & Cloud
• CLI Command: `redstrike graph run / campaign run`
• DAG Attack Plans: YAML attack dependency graphs
• Starter Templates: Recon, ADCS Audit, PrivEsc
• AI Clients: Claude Desktop · Cursor · Cline · Agents
• FastMCP Server: Typed tools & BloodHound cypher
• [GATED Mode — Safe / Default]: Read-only discovery runs freely. High-risk actions (DCSync, Cert Forging, ACL writes, Password resets) PAUSE for HITL approval.
• [AUTONOMOUS Mode — Unrestricted]: Full autonomous AI agency strictly bounded by `scope.yaml` IP/CIDRs and allowed domain suffixes.
• Fail-Closed Verification: Cryptographic success markers, return codes, and output pattern audits.
• Concurrency throttling, target cooldowns, and automatic teardown queue for modified objects.
• Zero Shell Injection: Strictly structured argument vectors (`list[str]`) with real-time secret redaction.
• Evidence Normalization: Raw command outputs parsed into typed Pydantic `EvidenceRecord` models.
• Credential Ledger (SSoT): Automatically captures and indexes NT hashes, Kerberos tickets, and DA privileges.
• Audit Provenance: Cryptographic `audit_id` linkage on every observation (Zero hallucination / Zero fabrication).
• Continuous telemetry and state stream returned to the DAG Graph Runner and LLM Agent Brain.
Python ≥ 3.10 · Policy-Gated Active Directory & ADCS Engine · Typed Command Builders · FastMCP & REST API
